summary: ADR 0069 makes the Agent loop ceilings operator configuration: CONCHBASE_MAX_ITERATIONS (1-64, default 6), CONCHBASE_MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_TURN (1-16, default 4), and CONCHBASE_LOOP_DEADLINE_MS (1000-1800000, default 120000). Values are validated at startup, published as loopBudget on GET /v1/runtime, and never settable by a task, client, Agent revision, or model.
